dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Welcome to the gym, Nam! What do you want to do today?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛlkəm tə ðə ˈdʒɪm, ˈnɑːm! ˈwʌt duː juː ˈwɑːnt tə ˈduː təˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I want to be healthy. What's the best exercise?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə bi ˈhɛlθi. ˈwʌts ðə ˈbɛst ˈɛksərsaɪz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Swimming is great exercise. It's good for all your muscles.
dialogue.reading: ˈswɪmɪŋ ɪz ˈɡreɪt ˈɛksərsaɪz. ɪts ˈɡʊd fər ˈɔːl jʊr ˈmʌsəlz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But the pool is far from my room.
dialogue.reading: bʌt ðə ˈpuːl ɪz ˈfɑːr frəm maɪ ˈruːm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then try the treadmill. Running is good exercise, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈtraɪ ðə ˈtrɛdmɪl. ˈrʌnɪŋ ɪz ˈɡʊd ˈɛksərsaɪz, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My legs are tired from jogging. Is walking OK?
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈlɛɡz ər ˈtaɪərd frəm ˈdʒɑːɡɪŋ. ɪz ˈwɔːkɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sure. Walking fast is good for you. And doing yoga is good for your back.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ˈwɔːkɪŋ ˈfæst ɪz ˈɡʊd fər juː. ənd ˈduːɪŋ ˈjoʊɡə ɪz ˈɡʊd fər jʊr ˈbæk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! I'll walk on the treadmill, then do yoga.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! aɪl ˈwɔːk ɑːn ðə ˈtrɛdmɪl, ˈðɛn ˈduː ˈjoʊɡə.
